Monocyte scRNAseq data from the Berlin cohort of Schulte-Schrepping et al is loaded as a Seurat object.
Gene counts are summed by groups specified by severity_donor_experiment_sex_day
only samples consisting of more than 200 cells are take into the analyisis



ThSruat object of monocytes in the 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(Seurat)
library("textTinyR")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyseurat)
```


```{r function}

make_idents_counts <- function(
    ds,
    idents_choose="seurat_clusters",
    assay_="RNA",
    slot_="counts",
    min_cell_num=100){
        
        Idents(ds) <- idents_choose
        group_names <- unique(Idents(ds))
        reads <- slot(ds, "assays")[[assay_]] %>% slot(slot_)
        reads <- reads[rownames(reads) %>% str_subset(pattern = "[.]",negate = T),]
        sum_counts_ds <- tibble(.rows =  nrow(reads))
        #z=1
        for (i in seq_along(group_names)) {
          #print(colnames(sum_counts_ds))
          print(i)
          i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = group_names[i])
          if (length(i_cells)<min_cell_num) {
            sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=0)
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num))
          # print(paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num)))
          # print(i)
            
            #if (z==2) (return(sum_counts_ds))
          #z=z+1
          next}
          #i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes_C19-CB-0003")
          sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=reads[,i_cells] %>%  sparse_Sums(rowSums=T))
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- as.character(group_names[i])
          #print(as.character(colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i]))
          
        }
        #colnames(sum_counts_ds) <- group_names
        sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%  mutate(gene=rownames(reads)) %>% relocate(gene)
        return(sum_counts_ds)
}


vulcano_plot_highlight_fc_p <- function(table,log2fc_thresh=1, padj_tresh=0.05){
  res_highlight <- table%>% 
   mutate(highlight=ifelse((abs(log2FoldChange)>log2fc_thresh) & (padj<padj_tresh), "highlight", "not")) %>% 
    # mutate(highlight=ifelse(gene %in% c("MAF>1B"), "sig", "not")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(highlight)) |> arrange(highlight)
  
  plot <- res_highlight %>% 
    ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=highlight), alpha=0.5)+ 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("highlight"="red", "not"= "black", "outlier"="blue"),
                     aesthetics = c("colour", "fill"))+
geom_label_repel(data = filter(res_highlight, highlight!= "not"),
                 aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj),label=gene),arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.01, "npc")),box.padding = 0.5)+
  # geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1.5,1.5), linetype="dashed") +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype="dashed")+
  theme_bw() 
  return(plot)
  
  
}

vulcano_plot_highlight_genes <- function(table,genes){
  res_highlight <- table%>% 
   mutate(highlight=ifelse(gene %in% genes, "highlight", "not")) %>% 
    # mutate(highlight=ifelse(gene %in% c("MAF>1B"), "sig", "not")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(highlight)) |> arrange(highlight)
  
  plot <- res_highlight %>% 
    ggplot(aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=highlight), alpha=0.5)+ 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("highlight"="red", "not"= "grey20", "outlier"="blue"),
                     aesthetics = c("colour", "fill"))+
geom_label_repel(data = filter(res_highlight, highlight!= "not"),
                 aes(log2FoldChange, -log(padj),label=gene),arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.01, "npc")),box.padding = 0.5)+
    geom_point(data=filter(res_highlight, highlight!= "not"),aes(color=highlight), color="red")+
  # geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1.5,1.5), linetype="dashed") +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype="dashed")+
  theme_bw() 
  return(plot)
  
  
}
```

```{r}
n_tbl <- tibble( 
               donor=seurat_monocytes$donor, 
               experiment=seurat_monocytes$experiment,
               sex=seurat_monocytes$sex,
               severity=seurat_monocytes$group_per_sample,

  group_by(donor,experiment,sex, severity,day_pso) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>%  mutate(keep=paste0(severity,"__",
                     donor,"__",
                     experiment,"__",
                     sex,"__",

  ungroup()
```

```{r}

  tibble(dings=.) %>% separate(col= dings,into = c("severity","donor", "experiment", "sex", "day"),sep = "__") %>%
  mutate_all(as_factor) |>
  mutate(day=as.double(as.character(day)))
design_x |> arrange(severity)

```

all severe cases were sequenced in the same sequencing run, therefore a design matrix with both factors is not full rank.
```{r}
design_x$donor[design_x$donor |> duplicated()]
```
Furthermore, four donors are duplicated and are all in the mild group. They cannot be included in the design matrix because non are severe and mild.

```{r }

res_sev_day_sex<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_x,
                              design= ~ 
                                severity +
                                day+
                                sex #
                              #donor +
                              #experiment
                             ) %>% DESeq()

res_sev_day_sex_interact<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_x,
                              design= ~ 
                                severity +
                                day+
                                sex + severity:day
                                #
                              #donor +
                              #experiment
                             ) %>% DESeq()

res_sev_sex<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_x,
                              design= ~ 
                                severity +
                                sex 
                             ) %>% DESeq()
  

res_day_sex <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_x,
                              design= ~
                                day +
                                sex 
                             ) %>%  DESeq()

resultsNames(res_sev_day_sex)
```

```{r}
mild_vs_severe_sev_day_sex <- results(res_sev_day_sex,contrast = c("severity","mild","severe")) |> as_tibble(rownames="gene")
mild_vs_severe_sev_sex <- results(res_sev_sex,contrast = c("severity","mild","severe")) |> as_tibble(rownames="gene")
day_sev_sex <- results(res_sev_day_sex, name="day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

day_sex <- results(res_day_sex, name="day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

sev_day_sex_interact <- results(res_sev_day_sex_interact, name="severitysevere.day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

shrink_sev_day_sex_interact<- lfcShrink(dds = res_sev_day_sex_interact,
          coef="severitysevere.day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")


shrink_mild_vs_severe_sev_day_sex <- lfcShrink(dds = res_sev_day_sex,
          coef="severity_severe_vs_mild")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

shrink_mild_vs_severe_sev_sex <- lfcShrink(dds = res_sev_sex,
          coef="severity_severe_vs_mild")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

shrink_day_sev_sex <- lfcShrink(dds = res_sev_day_sex,
          coef="day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")

shrink_day_sex <- lfcShrink(dds = res_sev_day_sex,
          coef="day")|> as_tibble(rownames="gene")
```

```{r}
fc_dif <- shrink_mild_vs_severe_sev_day_sex |> mutate(log2FoldChange=log2FoldChange*(-1),model="shrink_sev_day_sex") |> 
  bind_rows(shrink_mild_vs_severe_sev_sex|> mutate(log2FoldChange=log2FoldChange*(-1),model="shrink_sev_sex")) |> 
  #group_by(model) |>

  select(gene,log2FoldChange,model) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = log2FoldChange, names_prefix = "log2FC_") |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(log2FoldChange_dif=log2FC_shrink_sev_day_sex-log2FC_shrink_sev_sex)
```
